_readme: Settings for hedge_tracker.py. Paths are relative to this file. Demand shapes are read from shape_workbook; everything else (strips, volumes, coverage, origin weights) is edited here. All products, volumes and weights below are illustrative examples.
_history_start: First price date tracked. Anchored so the look-back keeps growing as new days arrive. Set to null to use a rolling window of lookback_years instead.
_origin_blend: Mt B TET = Enterprise (TEPPCO / Texas Eastern system); Mt B Non-TET = LST. Weights must sum to 1.
